summary: No agent-mode design anti-patterns found. The implementation correctly removes shell-based prompt builders (which pre-fetched diffs/file contents into prompts) and replaces them with objective-oriented prompts that tell agents what to do and where to find resources, letting agents fetch what they need. Review verdicts use JSON appropriately (machine-consumed by the orchestrator's verdict aggregation logic, not human-facing). Phase restrictions in prompts are informational only — actual enforcement is at the gateway sandbox level via phase_filter.py. No post-processing pipelines were introduced.
